result.summary: REVIEWER PASS, 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 3 MINOR. Reviewed git diff origin/main...HEAD (impl c4944af4a). OTP: raising in Pool.init/1 is acceptable; gen_server init catches the exception and GenServer.start returns {:error, {exception, stacktrace}} with nothing registered or linked, which is what T5 asserts (capture_log silences the crash report). Scope: only the listed files plus issue record/handoffs. Reset semantics unchanged when the guard passes (guard is read-only SELECT after Sandbox.mode(:auto), before GenServer.start/create_slots; init map gains one key, read with Map.get so a direct start without it works). Decision records: no conflict (test-support only, no framework choice); design paragraph sits in section 8 of the ISS-1042 design doc and matches the code. Tests: T1..T5 meaningful, T2 asserts both names in message, T4 uses a fresh module and unique slug with before/after deltas, T5 stops a leaked worker; async:false inherited, no pool/schema/process-dict leak. Mutant table is plausible against the diff (M1/M2a/M2b fail only T4 since start_pool! precedes worker; M5 only T5; M6 only T3 since T2 name still letflow_test*). Anti-patterns: no relevant entry. Type-safety: no new gap (string name check is inherent to a runtime DB identity).

findings.text: Pool.init/1 could return {:stop, {:not_test_database, msg}} instead of raising, avoiding a crash report; raising is fail-closed and tested, so not required.
Guard runs twice per start_pool! (once in the caller, once in init), two cheap SELECT current_database() queries; intentional defense in depth, noted only.
Prefix check is String.starts_with?("letflow_test"), so a database such as letflow_testing would pass; combined with equality to the configured name this is acceptable.
